verdict.rationale: The evidence pack details many UI-exclusive Claude.ai features (Cowork, voice mode, computer use, memory/chat search, artifacts, browser extension, scheduled tasks) but contains no documentation that these capabilities are exposed through the Claude API, nor any statement of API/UI feature parity. Enterprise API mentions are limited to a Compliance API for logs, not general feature parity. [2026-09-30 judge-migration owner-product bias audit: reverted opus-5-5 partial q3 -> the committed sonnet-5 baseline none q0. The rationale concedes nothing shows UI features (Projects, memory, Cowork, scheduled tasks, voice, connectors) exposed via API, and the OpenAPI probe 404s are affirmative counter-evidence; a Compliance API for usage data is an admin surface, not parity. Anthropic-affiliation governance, README §9.]
